facts.value: Geographic scope: per_municipality_boundary. Route local streetlight fixture outage to municipality. If pole wire box or supply side is sparking use utility plus CD. Route ordinary local street potholes and neighborhood paving to the resolved municipality. Route ordinary sidewalks to municipality; ask HITL if tied to highway works or MPWT asset. Route local blockage to municipality but escalate to MPWT for main/classified route and CD for immediate danger. Local road snow issues start with municipality; national route closure requires MPWT and rescue danger requires CD.
facts.notes: Runtime routing may still need exact location, dynamic municipal resolution, or asset-owner confirmation.
